verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS work-management tool like Linear, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics opt-out or related privacy controls; the items cover changelog features, customer requests, the API, agents and the MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
